# Particle Charts

> A zero-dependency JavaScript charting library that renders data as a living
> cloud of particles on a `<canvas>`. Bar, line, bubble, radar, pie and donut.
> ~20 kB minified and gzipped, responsive, accessible and typed. MIT licensed.

Particle Charts takes plain JSON and draws it as particles that spring into
position. Axes, ticks, legends and tooltips are generated from the data. Every
chart ships a visually hidden data table for screen readers, honours
`prefers-reduced-motion`, and pauses when scrolled out of view or when the tab
is hidden.

Install with `npm install particle-charts`, or drop in
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/particle-charts@1/dist/particle-charts.min.js`
and call `new ParticleCharts.ParticleChart('#el', { type: 'bar', data })`.

## Docs

- [Full documentation in Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bwilliford/particleCharts/main/README.md): every option, data shape and method, as raw Markdown
- [README, rendered](https://github.com/bwilliford/particleCharts/blob/main/README.md): the same document on GitHub
- [Options reference](https://particlecharts.com/#api): every top-level config key with its default
- [Quick start](https://particlecharts.com/#start): script tag, npm and ESM usage in three lines

## Interactive

- [Live demo and playground](https://particlecharts.com/#playground): change type, density, size, bloom and jitter and read the generated config
- [Chart types](https://particlecharts.com/#types): bar, line, bubble, radar, pie and donut, each as the same particle field

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/bwilliford/particleCharts): source, issues and releases
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/particle-charts): published builds
- [TypeScript declarations](https://github.com/bwilliford/particleCharts/blob/main/index.d.ts): full typings for the config object

## Optional

- [Showcase](https://particlecharts.com/#showcase): projects built with the library
